mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.1% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth exceeding 146,000 thousand persons signals robust labor market conditions, increasing consumer spending capacity and driving positive S&P 500 returns within 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative when PAYEMS > 146000 in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing units sold (HOUST) and decreases in residential sales value (RSAFS) indicate a weakening housing market due to price declines, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when HOUST > 1100 AND RSAFS < 470000 in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation below 245.0 indicates stable price levels, reducing real interest rate uncertainty and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days during low-inflation regimes.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 245.0.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing output below 101.0 (INDPRO) reflects economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as corporate earnings face demand pressure.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 101.0.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 4.4% indicates tight labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.4%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent GDP growth above 19,000 billion dollars (GDPC1) and rising housing starts (HOUST) signal robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative when GDPC1 > 19000 AND HOUST > 1100 in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary easing conditions (FEDFUNDS < 1.1% and CPIAUCSL < 245.0) reduce real interest rates, increasing equity valuation multiples and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1.1 AND CPIAUCSL < 245.0.
